ui_bugs.issue: React Rules-of-Hooks violation crashed the modal on open. Line 162 had `if (!open) return null;` placed BEFORE two useEffect hooks (lines 165, 181). Author had silenced the eslint warnings with eslint-disable comments. When `open` toggled, the number of hooks changed between renders, producing 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render' and the modal failed to render any content. FIXED: moved the early return after both hooks; useEffect now guards with `if (!open) return undefined;` and adds `open` to deps. Verified: modal opens, polling progresses, 3 plans render, save-all flows to Compare tab.

rca of the issue: AIStrategistModal crash RCA: React requires the SAME number of hooks called on every render. The code had `if (!open) return null;` at line 162, BEFORE two `useEffect` calls at lines 165 and 181. The first render (open=false) returned early and executed 5 hooks (4 useState + 1 useRef). The second render (open=true) executed those 5 plus 2 useEffect = 7 hooks. React threw 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render.' The eslint-disable comments silenced the lint warning but the runtime bug remained. Mitigation applied: moved the early return AFTER both useEffects, added `if (!open) return undefined;` inside the first useEffect, and added `open` to its dependency array.
